articles.title: STOKE FOOTWEAR LAUNCHES TO CELEBRATE THE 65 MILLION ALL-AMERICAN GUYS FORGOTTEN BY ATHLETIC FOOTWEAR
articles.mainIdea: STOKE FOOTWEAR LAUNCHES TO CELEBRATE THE 65 MILLION ALL-AMERICAN GUYS FORGOTTEN BY ATHLETIC FOOTWEAR
articles.summary: PR Newswire: STOKE FOOTWEAR LAUNCHES TO CELEBRATE THE 65 MILLION ALL-AMERICAN GUYS FORGOTTEN BY ATHLETIC FOOTWEAR. Today marks the official launch of STOKE Footwear, a new casual-lifestyle brand founded by footwear veteran Rick Blackshaw, built to serve the 65 million all-American guys overlooked by today's athletic footwear giants. The brand's website is now live at stokeshoes.com, and STOKE will launch in 450+ retail doors nationwide on March 1, including Scheels, Academy Sports + Outdoors, Rack Room Shoes, Shoe Department, Shoe Sensation, Murdoch's, Runnings, and a strong network of independent retailers.

articles.title: This Equinox Executive Says Your Game of Golf Isn’t Exercise
articles.mainIdea: This Equinox Executive Says Your Game of Golf Isn’t Exercise
articles.summary: The Wall Street Journal: This Equinox Executive Says Your Game of Golf Isn’t Exercise. Harvey Spevak calls himself a “human guinea pig” because of all the health and wellness trends he’s tried. Executive chairman and managing partner of fitness-club company Equinox Group says he’s all in on body scans, infrared saunas and even paid $10,000 to have his blood cleansed of toxins, an experience he said he “can’t wait to do again.” “I used to do IV drips at my desk during internal meetings,” Spevak, 61, says.
